title: jams engine asset sidecar, format v1

$schema.description: The asset sidecar JSON Schema this file follows.

key.description: The asset's registry key, which never changes; omitted when it equals `id`.

id.description: The asset's id, unique among the project's live assets.

assetKind.description: The asset kind (`texture`, or `<game>/<kind>` for a game's); omitted when the file's suffix or content gives it.

name.description: Display name; omitted when it is the file's stem.

sha256.description: A binary asset's SHA-256, 64 lowercase hex characters.

bytes.description: A binary asset's size in bytes.

import.description: Import settings the asset's kind defines (a texture's `filter`).

meta.description: What the kind's inspector read from the file; never hand-edited.

source.description: Where it came from: a URL or a description.

attribution.description: The exact credit line the licence asks for; the credits page prints it.

description: The metadata of the asset in the file beside it (`<file>.asset.json`): its key, id, kind, content hash, import settings and licence.
